summary: Test-writing run for issue #39. Added a solver parity test target (ColorComposerCore/Tests/ColorComposerCoreTests/SolverParityTests.swift + ParityCorpus.swift) that vendors the real viamin/color_matching#111 corpus (12 scenarios, including three tie cases and two all-excluded cases) and replays WeightedSquaredErrorScorer against it with earliest-index-wins selection. The OpenAPI client migration and README documentation are implementation-phase work out of scope for this TDD-boundary (tests/docs-only) run and are recorded as not_run below.

references.result: unchanged - swift-openapi-generator/runtime dependency and generated client are implementation-phase work; this run is restricted to test paths and the LID doc allowlist (docs/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md) per the TDD boundary, so PaletteAPIClient was not touched

pre-existing coverage left untouched; no code changed this run that could affect cache/offline/fallback behavior. Re-verification is implementation-phase work for the follow-up run that performs the client migration
written; asserts per-candidate scores/exclusions, selected index, selected hex, selected error, and tied-index score agreement for all 12 corpus scenarios
written; pins the corpus's declared scorer (ColorMatching.WeightedSquaredError) and selection policy (earliest-index-wins) so a future corpus refresh with a different policy fails loudly

vendored verbatim from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/viamin/color_matching/main/priv/parity/v1/corpus.json (algorithm_version 1, 12 scenarios) after confirming issue viamin/color_matching#111 is closed upstream

references.locator: manual verification (no Swift toolchain in this sandbox; bin/lint confirms and no-ops: 'Swift toolchain not available; skipping build and tests')
references.result: re-implemented the WeightedSquaredErrorScorer algorithm and earliest-index-wins selection in Python and replayed it against the vendored corpus.json directly: 12/12 scenarios match expected scores, exclusions, selected index/hex/error, and tied-index sets exactly. Swift source was reviewed line-by-line against existing call sites (ScorerTests.swift, ChannelWeights.swift, CompositionScorer.swift, CompositionSolver.swift.bestCandidate) for API/type correctness, but `swift test` itself could not be executed in this environment and must still be run in CI/on a host with the Swift toolchain before merge

this run produces a tests-only draft PR per the TDD-boundary workflow; parity findings (ties: tie-symmetric-around-target, tie-duplicate-vectors, tie-three-way-on-lps, zero-weight-channel-missing, mixed-large-palette; exclusions: missing-candidate-excluded, missing-target-excluded, all-excluded; unknown weight key ignored: unknown-weight-ignored) are captured here for the implementation PR description to carry forward once paid-tests-approved unlocks that run
